ownership_audit.note: The shared Phase 4 gate is runnable and reversible, but the repo does not yet name an explicit rollback owner for keeping this build entrypoint honest.

The bounded diff files give file-local expectations and a fallback gate, but there is still no explicit rollback-owner record for deciding who reverts or narrows those file-local expectations when parity drifts.
The recommended Phase 4 sample destinations are still absent from the live repo, so there is no honest rollback owner or fallback path recorded for those roadmap anchors yet.

lab_matrix_audit.note: The current bootstrap workflow runs one Phase 4 build entrypoint, which keeps the diff gates live but does not widen them into a named CI matrix.

lab_matrix_audit.scope: cross-target or multi-configuration CI for Phase 4 validation
lab_matrix_audit.note: Phase 4 has no dedicated CI matrix analogous to the existing Phase 2 cross-target matrix, so measurability remains single-path.

lab_matrix_audit.scope: manual or documented lab replay grid for the Linux anchors
lab_matrix_audit.note: There is still no Phase 4 lab matrix note that records hardware, kernel config, or replay-command coverage for the four roadmap anchors.
The roadmap calls for perf baselines and thresholds, but the repo still has no committed Phase 4 threshold note or baseline artifact.

gaps.why_now: The shared Phase 4 build step is the smallest honest place to keep rollback-readiness gates reviewable while the broader measurability surface is still thin.
The Phase 4 validator already keeps the existing gates wired into docs and workflow, so it is the right place to make the new survey surface non-optional.
A dedicated Phase 4 note is the smallest truthful place to compare the landed diff gates against the roadmap's stronger rollback-ownership and matrix promises.
A committed manifest keeps the measurability inventory reviewable instead of leaving it buried in one scheduled-run note.
A dedicated survey gate lets bootstrap fail when the ownership or matrix inventory silently drifts away from the current Phase 4 build surface.
The existing diff gates are reversible, but the repo still does not name an explicit rollback owner for either the shared Phase 4 build gate or the two bounded diff files.
The roadmap explicitly calls for a lab matrix and CI matrix, yet current Phase 4 coverage stops at one shared bootstrap path with no named lab matrix.
Phase 4 still lacks a bounded perf baseline and threshold note even though the roadmap names that evidence as part of making the future ports measurable.

The recommended Phase 4 sample destinations are still absent from the live repo, so a real rollback owner and matrix story for those anchors should wait for a narrow reference-pattern step instead of pretending the sample ports already exist.
